password_reset.subject: Reset your password on {server}
password_reset.body:
Hello {username},

Someone asked to reset the password for your account on {server}. To choose a new password, open this link:

{link}

The link works once, for {lifetime}.

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

test.subject: Test email from {server}
test.body:
Hello {username},

This is the test email you sent from {server}'s mail settings. Email from this server is working.

test_result.sent: The test email was sent to your address. If it isn't in your inbox, check your spam folder.
test_result.not_configured: The test email wasn't sent, because email isn't set up on this server. Add an SMTP host and a From address to the mail settings.
test_result.settings_unreadable: The test email wasn't sent, because the saved SMTP password can't be read. This happens when the server's encryption key changes. Enter the SMTP password again in the mail settings.
test_result.auth_failed: The test email wasn't sent, because the SMTP server didn't accept the user name or password. Check them in the mail settings.
test_result.host_unreachable: The test email wasn't sent, because this server couldn't connect to the SMTP host. Check the host and port in the mail settings.
test_result.tls_failed: The test email wasn't sent, because a secure connection to the SMTP host failed. Check the connection security and the port in the mail settings.
test_result.rejected: The test email wasn't sent, because the SMTP server refused the sender or the recipient. Check the From address in the mail settings.
test_result.send_failed: The test email wasn't sent, because something went wrong while sending it. Try again, and check the worker's log if it keeps failing.
